subject: Playground credit augmentation for overnight latency soak
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <agomez@brightcart.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — extra playground credits for overnight soak

Hey Sergio,

We're planning a 12-hour latency/throughput soak this Thursday night to validate our edge routing and KV-cache behavior under sustained load. The current sandbox allotment will cap us well short of the target traffic. Can Redwood provision a short-term top-up (non-billable) so we can run the full sequences?

Rough ask: +150k token-equivalent credit from 2027-12-09 00:00 UTC through 2027-12-12 23:59 UTC. We'll run 3 waves (warmup + two 4-hour ramps).

I've attached our load plan (load-plan.csv) and a brief scope doc. If you need a PO or an exec approval, tell me where to route it.

Thanks,
Alex Gomez
Director of Platform Engineering — BrightCart
agomez@brightcart.com

Attachments: load-plan.csv (CSV, 16 KB)
From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <agomez@brightcart.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 11:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — extra playground credits for overnight soak

Alex — thanks for the details and the load plan. This is doable but want to confirm a couple quick things before I route to provisioning:

- Confirm the total token-equivalent: you wrote ~150k — is that aggregate over the window or per-day?
- Any sensitive data in the test set? (we can provision a private sandbox if required)

Jordan, looping you in to propose a concrete temporary allowance and the best way to track the soak from our side (tracing hooks, per-route latency dashboards).

Sergio Alvarez
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: jordan.blake@redwood.com <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, Alex Gomez <agomez@brightcart.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 13:20:44 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — extra playground credits for overnight soak

Alex / Sergio — reviewed the CSV and the planned waves. Proposed approach:

- Temporary top-up: +150,000 token-equivalent (sandbox), available immediately on provisioning.
- Expiration: 2027-12-12T23:59:00Z (matches your window).
- Observability: we'll enable a dedicated route ID for your soak (brightcart-soak-9345) so you get per-route token/latency breakdowns in the Console.
- Fallbacks: if we detect error-rate > 2% for 15 minutes, we auto-throttle and notify the on-call.

I attached a quick provisioning checklist (provisioning-instructions.txt) with the fields ops will need. For procurement — if you want this formally captured we can accept a simple PO; otherwise we can do it as a trial extension.

Attachments: provisioning-instructions.txt

If that lines up, Sergio — can you run this through for a non-billable sandbox top-up?

—Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Alex
